label: Discord
tagline: One bot on Twitch and Discord. Go-live, clips, welcomes, tickets, and voice.
description: Connect an existing Discord server or create one from Bagel’s template. Go-live and clips post from outgress directly. They never wait on sesame. Raids, gift bombs, and milestone subs copy into #announcements when you turn those on. The Discord gateway (dingress) handles welcomes, join-to-create voice, support tickets, staff logs, slash moderation, and crumb ranks.
